metadata.title: LUMIX DC-S1M2 'Save 1st Normal Picture' Subtag 0x030f Evidence & Firmware Correlation
metadata.investigation_mode: Strictly read-only offline analysis; no physical camera connection; no firmware mutation; no unknown binary execution

prohibitions_and_boundary_definitions.candidate_nature: Serialized configuration backup record in PTP payload (.DAT/.CAM), strictly NOT a hardware MMIO register
prohibitions_and_boundary_definitions.data_nature: Menu state integer flag, strictly NOT raw sensor Bayer stream or all-input RAW buffer
prohibitions_and_boundary_definitions.protocol_tag_nature: Internal serialization sub-record ID (0x030f), strictly NOT identical to PTP property codes (e.g. 0x0200xxxx / 0x94xx)

01_baseline.description: Baseline state (High-Res OFF, Fan initial, Save 1st Normal default)

02_highres_on.description: Sample A1: High-Res ON, Save 1st Normal ON, Fan initial

03_highres_off.description: Sample B: High-Res ON, Save 1st Normal OFF, Fan turned ON (dual variable)

04_highres_on_fan.description: Sample A2: High-Res ON, Save 1st Normal ON, Fan ON (accidental Group Z shift)

05_highres_off_fan.description: Sample B2: High-Res ON, Save 1st Normal OFF, Fan fixed ON (clean single-variable reversal)

targets_inspected.scope: Full arm64 disassembly (476k lines ptp, 286k lines app)
targets_inspected.findings: Zero occurrences of Subtag 0x030f as a configuration descriptor. Tether treats .DAT files as opaque byte streams transferred via PTP 0x9422/0x9423 without parsing. Remote Menu (0x9416) is a virtual touch coordinate relay (0..999) with zero camera menu item schema.

targets_inspected.source: Panasonic GPL Linux Kernel & U-Boot (linux-4.19.124 & u-boot)
targets_inspected.scope: All platform drivers, DTS/DTSI, arch/arm64, drivers/pvc
targets_inspected.findings: Contains hardware SoC drivers for Milbeaut SC2006A / PVC04V (UART, SDHCI, mass storage, PSCI EL3). Zero camera UI, settings serialization, or ISP high-res routines exist in open-source components.

targets_inspected.scope: Leica DC1231/MC501 kernel and u-boot trees
targets_inspected.findings: Identical Milbeaut SC2006A platform base; identical absence of userland or proprietary settings deserializers.

targets_inspected.scope: 62 components, including loader1, program, hr_c_prog, hr_d_prog
targets_inspected.findings: All functional execution binaries have flags=3, entropy > 7.997, and failed 100% of bootloader anchor pattern probes. No plaintext deserializer executable is exposed.

evidence_chain_break_analysis.break_point: Interface boundary between host PTP opaque buffer transport and in-camera proprietary RTOS deserialization routines
evidence_chain_break_analysis.host_side_reach: Host PC can dump (0x9423) and inject (0x9422) the 9.2 MB .DAT blob, and can verify the 8-bit checksum, but has no semantic interpreter for sub-records.
evidence_chain_break_analysis.camera_side_block: In-camera deserialization, state validation, and high-res computation logic reside inside encrypted firmware partitions (program, hr_c_prog) executed in ARM TrustZone / RTOS domain.
unsupported_inferences: Inferring that Subtag 0x030f corresponds to PTP property tag 0x0200030f (INVALID: PTP property space is separate)
Inferring that Subtag 0x030f is a memory-mapped hardware register (INVALID: it is a serialized TLV struct in a backup file)
Inferring that enabling Save 1st Normal Picture exports all 8/16 input RAWs (INVALID: official manual states it exports only 1 normal shot)

immediately_verifiable_next_steps: Run analysis/read_s1m2_known_setting.py on all current and future sample dumps to maintain automated regression verification.
Systematically map the surrounding subtag range (0x0308 to 0x0320) within Record 0x0004 across existing dumps to document structural field lengths, slot counts, and flags.
Formally maintain the strict offline, read-only boundary without attempting camera injection or firmware tampering until an authenticated or verified execution path is discovered.
